notes.title: DreadOut Remastered Collection Update: All Bonus Contents, Free!
notes.notes:
As a thank you for supporting DreadOut Remastered Collection, we’re releasing something special, and it’s completely FREE!



The DLC essentially contains all of DreadOut's past extra content. In details:
DreadOut: The Untolds Webcomic 
12 high-resolution episodes revealing hidden fragments of Linda’s journey, revealing her untold stories of DreadOut.


Official DreadOut Manga
100+ pages written and illustrated by Indonesian artists, expanding the haunting world of DreadOut.


Original Soundtrack and Background Music from DreadOut 
Featuring Indonesian Indie Bands including Mocca, Koil, Sarasvati, Sigmun, Tesla Manaf, and more.

Original OST by Adhitia Sulistiana Wibisana & Pratama Kusuma Putra, featuring Risa Saraswati.

Available in both MP3 & WAV formats.



You’ll find your free DLC in your installation folder: "DLC - Manga Soundtrack". We hope you enjoy the full content of DreadOut Remastered, and thank you for supporting this universe.



With love, Digital Happiness
